2607.21268.title: pAI-Econ-claude: A Gated Human-in-the-Loop Multi-Agent Architecture for AI-Assisted Economic Theory Development
2607.21268.paper_summary: In many social-science research tasks, such as economics, LLM-based agents must produce outputs for which no cheap, task-complete, machine-readable correctness signal exists. This creates a distinctive reliability problem for multi-agent systems: how should generation, critique, coordination, and human judgment be organized when no component can certify the final result? We address this problem through pAI-Econ-claude, a gated, human-in-the-loop multi-agent architecture for AI-assisted economic theory development. Agents coordinate through a shared workspace of inspectable intermediate records; specialized gates diagnose targeted failure modes and recommend loopbacks without certifying correctness; and human checkpoints retain authority over decisions that are costly to reverse. We evaluate the architecture on five matched economic-theory tasks against an ungated baseline. Two evaluators blinded to configuration agreed on all five pairwise rankings, preferring the gated architecture in four tasks and the baseline in one. Mean failure severity fell from 1.58 to 1.16, while overall usefulness rose from 2.60 to 3.10. The largest observed gain occurred when a reality check rejected a false market-structure premise and a proof review prompted revision of a false welfare claim. The negative case shows that scaffolding can also compress an economically important mechanism too aggressively. The results support a bounded claim: gated oversight improves the auditability of AI-assisted economic theory without substituting for formal verification, and the allocation of irreversible human judgment is a more informative design variable than pure agent autonomy. The workflow is publicly available at https://github.com/maxwell2732/pAI-Econ-claude.
2607.21268.paper_summary_zh: 在許多社會科學研究任務中，例如經濟學，基於LLM的代理必須產出沒有廉價、任務完整、機器可讀的正確性信號的結果。這為多代理系統創造了一個獨特的可靠性問題：當沒有任何組件可以認證最終結果時，生成、批評、協調和人類判斷應如何組織？我們通過pAI-Econ-claude來解決這個問題，這是一個有閘的人類參與的多代理架構，用於AI輔助的經濟理論發展。代理通過可檢查的中間記錄的共享工作空間進行協調；專門的閘門診斷針對性的失敗模式並建議回路，而不認證正確性；人類檢查點保留對難以逆轉決策的權威。我們在五個匹配的經濟理論任務上評估了該架構，與一個無閘的基線進行比較。兩位對配置保持盲目的評估者在所有五個成對排名上達成一致，四個任務中偏好有閘架構，只有一個任務中偏好基線。平均失敗嚴重性從1.58降至1.16，而整體有用性從2.60上升至3.10。觀察到的最大增益發生在現實檢查拒絕了一個錯誤的市場結構前提，並且證明審查促使修訂了一個錯誤的福利主張。負面案例顯示，支架也可能過於激進地壓縮一個經濟上重要的機制。結果支持一個有限的主張：有閘的監督提高了AI輔助經濟理論的審計能力，而不替代正式驗證，且不可逆的人類判斷的分配是一個比純代理自主性更具信息性的設計變量。該工作流程可在https://github.com/maxwell2732/pAI-Econ-claude公開獲得。
